Max tokens limit the length of the AI\'s response. A higher number allows longer replies but may increase costs. Default is 12000.
The timeout defines how long the app will wait for the AI response before terminating the request. Longer values allow the model more time to generate answers. Default is 5 minutes.
You can set Effort or Max reasoning tokens, not both. Setting Max reasoning tokens turns Effort off. To use Effort, leave Max reasoning tokens empty.

Creates and saves a text-based file (TXT, HTML, JSON, Markdown and so on) in the %1$s folder.
Deletes existing files from the %1$s workspace.
Gets your current precise location with Plus Code, coordinates, map links and accuracy.

AI-optimized web search that returns extracted page content (text, tables, code). Adjustable: freshness (day, week, month, year or a date range), result count (1–50), context size (1K–32K tokens), relevance threshold (strict, balanced or lenient) and SafeSearch.
A dedicated news index for recent articles from trusted outlets. Adjustable: freshness (day, week, month, year or a date range), article count (1–50) and SafeSearch.
Finds businesses, landmarks and points of interest by place name or coordinates. Adjustable: search query, location (name or latitude and longitude) and radius in meters (default 5000).
Starts the Android timer, with an optional title.
Creates a system alarm for a specific time, with an optional title. Say AM or PM.
Adds an event to your calendar. Needs a title and a start date and time. An all-day flag and a location are optional.
Lists files and folders in the %1$s workspace, including subfolders.
Reads a text-based file from the %1$s workspace.
Creates a new subfolder in the %1$s workspace.
Opens an existing file from the %1$s folder in the system\'s default app. GradatiON has to be in the foreground for this to work.
Overwrites an existing file with new content. Use it to update a file and keep its name.
Copies a file to a new location or renames it. Adds a timestamp if the destination exists, so nothing is overwritten.
Converts between coordinates (latitude and longitude) and Plus Codes.
Starts Google Maps turn-by-turn navigation. Choose driving, walking, bicycling or transit, and what to avoid (such as tolls or highways).
Returns the current date and time with day, date, time (including seconds), time zone and UTC offset.
Opens an app by name or package, or opens a specific Android settings page.
Searches installed apps by name or package to find the right ID for launching.
Gets or sets the ringer mode (Normal, Vibrate or Silent).
Pauses for a set time (10–600 seconds). Use it for timed delays between repeated actions.
